services.desc: I’ve chartered multiple boats on vacations and locally over the years and have never found any charter to be more prepared and FUN than the Elizabeth Marie. Because Captain Rob Green and his crews are so customer friendly, my company also charters multiple events year after year. They ARE the boat to charter to catch fish AND have fun! -Steve Helle Elizabeth Marie fishing charters offers the opportunity for parents to spend time with their family and help their kids to catch fish, drop a lobster pot and have a great time. blurb: Guests join fishing charters from Scituate, MA, fishing around Boston Harbor, Stellwagen Bank, Mass Bay, Cape Cod Bay, and Plymouth. They target species including sharks, tuna, cod, haddock, striped bass, and bluefish. Trips cater to anglers of all skill levels and include family-friendly options like kids fishing charters and lobster trap pulling.
